“吴姜，我这次下山的报酬是五十万，我全部转给你吧，算是弥补你车子的损失了。”

吴姜却摆了摆手，说道：“不用，这跟你无关，赔偿也轮不到你来出。”

吴姜怎么好意思收云川的钱，这笔钱最应该掏的，是苏国维两兄弟。

毕竟他是受苏家所托，护送陶罐，车子受损也是因为苏家的事情，于情于理，都该苏家来承担。

云川见吴姜态度坚决，也不好再说什么，答应今天就联系苏国维，看他有什么说法。

两个小时后，到了龙虎山脚下，几人没急着上山，先在山下的餐馆，祭奠了一下五脏庙。

饭菜刚上桌，灵虚道长的手机就响了起来，看来电显示，正是怀安道长的电话。

“死胖子，这次还真让你说对了。这只恶鬼，确实是我们茅山的一位师叔当年亲手封印的。”

灵虚道长顿时来了精神，正想对着对面输出的时候，手机就被灵宸道长一把抢了过去。

“怀安师兄，到底是怎么回事？”

“是这么回事......”怀安道长叹了口气，缓缓道出了当年的往事。

听完怀安道长的解释，众人这才彻底明白，这只恶鬼的来历。

当年正值国难当头，天下大乱，民不聊生，就连神道也紊乱了，就连神道都陷入紊乱，阴阳失衡。

一些妖魔鬼怪，趁着战乱，四处兴风作浪，全靠一些道家高人，下山四处奔走，镇压邪祟、保护一方安宁。

这只恶鬼，当年就在战场上兴风作浪，专门吸食战死士兵的魂魄，实力一路飙升，硬生生晋级到了鬼将境。

茅山的那位前辈，为了镇压它，拼尽了全身修为，才勉强将它封印。

可最后，那位前辈也因灵力耗尽、伤势过重，回到茅山没多久就去世了。

吴姜在一旁听的一头雾水，但是有一句话，他听清楚了，那就是原来的那只恶鬼，封印之前的实力，是鬼将级别。

虽然吴姜不懂鬼将的含金量，但不妨碍他头皮发麻。

这时，菜已经上来了，大家默不作声的开始吃起饭来。

"Wu Jiang, my reward for going down the mountain this time is 500,000 yuan. I will transfer it all to you to make up for the loss of your car."

Wu Jiang waved his hand and said, "No, this has nothing to do with you, and it's not your turn to pay compensation."

Why did Wu Jiang have the nerve to accept Yunchuan's money? The two brothers Su Guowei should pay the most.

After all, he was entrusted by the Su family to escort the pots, and the damage to the car was also due to the Su family's affairs. The Su family should bear all the consequences, both emotionally and rationally.

Seeing that Wu Jiang was resolute, Yun Chuan couldn't say anything more and promised to contact Su Guowei today to see what he had to say.

Two hours later, when they arrived at the foot of Longhu Mountain, a few people were not in a hurry to go up the mountain. They first paid homage to the Five Internal Organs Temple at the restaurant at the foot of the mountain.

As soon as the food was served, Taoist Lingxu's cell phone rang. Looking at the caller ID, it was Taoist Huai'an's phone number.

"Damn fat man, you are really right this time. This evil ghost was indeed sealed by one of our uncles from Maoshan."

Taoist priest Lingxu suddenly became energetic, and just when he was about to send output to the other side, his cell phone was snatched away by Taoist priest Lingchen.

"Senior Brother Huai'an, what's going on?"

"That's what happened..." Taoist priest Huai'an sighed and slowly told the story of the past.

After listening to Taoist Huai'an's explanation, everyone finally understood the origin of this evil ghost.

At that time, the country was in crisis, the world was in chaos, the people were in dire straits, even the Shinto was in chaos, and the yin and yang were out of balance.

Some demons and ghosts took advantage of the chaos of war to cause trouble everywhere, and it was all thanks to some Taoist masters to go down the mountain and run around to suppress the evil spirits and protect the peace of the place.

This evil ghost was causing trouble on the battlefield back then, specializing in sucking the souls of soldiers killed in battle. Its strength soared, and it was suddenly promoted to the realm of ghost generals.

In order to suppress it, the senior from Maoshan tried his best to seal it.

But in the end, the senior was exhausted and seriously injured, and died not long after returning to Maoshan.

Wu Jiang was confused as he listened, but there was one sentence that he heard clearly. That was the original evil ghost. Before the seal, his strength was at the level of a ghost general.

Although Wu Jiang didn't understand the value of ghost generals, it didn't stop him from feeling numb.

By this time, the food had been served, and everyone began to eat in silence.
